senses.اسْتَوَى|0: To ascend and settle upon something, signifying divine authority and establishment.
senses.اسْتَوَى|1: To be equal and balanced, indicating parity or equivalence between two entities.
senses.واحِدَة|0: Signifying unity and harmony within a people or faith, a cohesive, undivided community.
senses.واحِدَة|1: Denoting a singular, instantaneous occurrence, happening once without repetition or multiplicity.
senses.يَمِين|0: A solemn oath or sacred vow, binding one to a promise or declaration.
senses.يَمِين|1: The right side, symbolizing honor, blessedness, and salvation for the righteous on Judgment Day.
senses.تَرَكَ|0: To leave behind an inheritance or estate, an involuntary legacy after one's passing.
senses.تَرَكَ|1: To intentionally preserve and immortalize a lasting legacy, like an enduring sign or good remembrance.
senses.بَعَثَ|0: To dispatch messengers to nations, conveying divine guidance and the sacred message.
senses.بَعَثَ|1: To resurrect the dead, reviving and gathering them for accountability on the Day of Judgment.
senses.أَخْرَجَ|0: To creatively bring forth life, reviving the dead, growing plants, or originating from a source.
senses.أَخْرَجَ|1: To forcibly expel or evict people from their homes, displacing them against their will.
senses.وَجْه|0: To turn one's intention towards God's pleasure or a sacred direction, a profound metaphor.
senses.وَجْه|1: The physical face, revealing one's state through radiance or gloom on Judgment Day.
senses.ضَرَبَ|0: To physically strike, travel the earth, or metaphorically impose, like pitching a tent of humiliation.
senses.ضَرَبَ|1: To present a parable or analogy in speech, illustrating and clarifying a profound meaning.
senses.سَجَدَ|0: To submit and prostrate in humble worship to God alone, earning divine reward.
senses.سَجَدَ|1: To bow in compliance with God's command, honoring Adam, not as worship, but respect.
senses.أَصْلَحَ|0: To reconcile, removing disputes and discord, establishing harmony and accord between adversaries.
senses.أَصْلَحَ|1: To reform oneself, rectifying corruption and straightening one's conduct after sincere repentance.
senses.بَرّ|0: The dry land or mainland, standing in clear contrast to the vast expanse of the sea.
senses.بَرّ|1: The righteous, pious, and truthful, who fulfill obedience and embody profound virtue.
senses.مَلَكَتْ|0: To possess power and control, wielding authority over both harm and benefit.
senses.مَلَكَتْ|1: To hold actual ownership, possessing slaves and maidservants as tangible property.
senses.عَيْن|0: The physical seeing eye, encompassing vision, perception, preservation, and watchful care.
senses.عَيْن|1: A gushing spring or fountain, a vital source of water emerging from the earth.
senses.حَيّ|0: True life: organic, growing, and sensitive existence, or God's eternal, self-subsisting being.
senses.حَيّ|1: Metaphorical life: resurrection, the hereafter, spiritual vitality, and the enduring life of martyrs.
